programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S32/E3 - Takeout: Home Delivery'. Guy brings Flavortown to his kitchen and reconnects via video chat with chefs. On the menu is primo pork from New Hampshire and Californian chicken Parmesan.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S6/E5 - Fuelling The Fires In Texas'. Roger returns to Texas and learns the tricks of two barbecue masters. He helps season two whole goats with a spice blend and visits a unique outdoor rig.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S6/E6 - Where There's Smoke'. Roger is in San Antonio, TX, to learn how chef Jason Dady makes paella flavoured with Thai ingredients. Then, he learns how to roast a goat in a Cajun microwave.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: 'S20/E21 - Roux The Day'. In Baton Rouge, owner Maurice claims to be proud of his restaurant, but his lack of leadership and inability to inspire his staff threaten to destroy the business.

programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Medieval Times Cake'. Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman conjure up cakes filled with special effects to celebrate the fantasy and fun of Medieval Times' 30th anniversary.

programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Medieval Times Cake'. Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman conjure up cakes filled with special effects to celebrate the fantasy and fun of Medieval Times' 30th anniversary.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E4 - Dallas'. Andrew Zimmern explores the big and bold flavours that are decidedly Dallas - from comforting chicken fried steak and sweet, creamy pecan pie to hearty tortilla soup.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E5 - Chiang Mai'. Andrew Zimmern reveals the most iconic foods of Chiang Mai, Thailand, from coconut curry soup and a sausage with pork and chilli paste, to fish roasted in banana leaves.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Boozy Baskets'. Four competing pastry chefs must turn adult drinks into pastry perfection. A special beer and a frozen treat are part of the puzzle in round one.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S31/E6 - Beat The Judges: Spicy'. Guy invites three spice experts to prove just how heated things can get. Which contestant will take on an all-star judge in the ultimate spicy showdown?

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S27/E12 - Recipes By Request'. The hosts are taking requests for easy, new and creative recipes. On the menu is easy smothered chicken, grilled red curry lamb chops, and perfect chocolate cake.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E6 - Savoring Sicily'. Guy Fieri's in Sicily, Italy, digging into primo prawns over squid ink pasta, A-list arancini and next-level ravioli.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E3 - Grudge Match: Battle 4'. Cooking legends face off for a chance at the $100,000 finale! In round one, the chefs must incorporate a sweet breakfast item into an appetiser.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Sweet Gamble'. Alex challenges the chefs to gamble with unsuspecting shoppers' carts and create the best nacho platter. Plus, they are asked to create a retro-goes-modern dish.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S39/E12 - All-Star Pizza'. Four all-star chefs make a pizzeria combo plate using only the grocery items they can carry on a pizza paddle in one trip.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S20/E7 - Favorites Part 2'. The team looks at viewers' favourite flavours and recipes, like easy smothered French onion chicken thighs. And, Katie Lee makes a new pizza crust using chickpeas.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Tiny Treats'. Four chefs create tiny treats that are little works of art. In the first basket, a savoury spread may fill them with dread, and a peculiar powder features in round two.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S1 - Shift 3: Resourcefulness (1)'. Fatigue sets in as the chefs face hours seven and eight while turning one bag of ingredients into three distinct meals for judge Scott Conant.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Shift 4: Teamwork'. Working with chefs they just met, the competitors strategize, collaborate and execute under the critical eyes of Michael and Bryan Voltaggio.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Shift 5: Artistry'. Exhaustion becomes palpable as chefs enter hour 13 of their 24-hour competition. The chefs turn microwave meals into works of art for Eric Adjepong.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S31/E7 - Fieri Thanksgiving Party'. The Fieri family is back as the three youngest members are paired up with all-star chefs to prepare a one-hour Thanksgiving feast!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S40/E8 - Burgers, Marrow And Bangladesh'. Guy Fieri grabs smoking smash burgers in East Boston, flavour-bursting bone marrow in Minneapolis and the-bomb Bengali-American fare in Ohio.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S40/E9 - From Vietnamese To Vegan'. Guy Fieri grabs grub from Vietnamese to vegan, including pork belly crepes in Minneapolis, BBQ Reubens in New Jersey and doughnuts in Montana.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S45/E5 - Champs Challenge: Part 4'. Four series champions return for a chance to win $50,000. In the second round, they are given chocolate fish, poblano peppers and squab.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S62/E1 - Fluke Rebuke'. The chefs find a peculiar cereal and fluke fillets in the first basket. The entrée round ingredients run the gamut from light to hearty.

programme.desc: 'S27/E13 - Spring To It!'. The hosts share simple, seasonal dinners for every night of the week. They include cavatelli with asparagus, lemon and ricotta, and black sea bass en papillote.

programme.desc: 'S42/E7 - Sicilian Adventure'. Guy Fieri's Sicilian trip continues as he eats creative twists on pizza, next-level langoustine spaghettone, and succulent seafood linguine.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E4 - Grudge Match: Battle 3'. Four champs who were previously defeated return to the kitchen, hungry for sweet redemption. Sardines are the main protein in the appetiser basket.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
